tasks.title: Fix v1->v2 config migration losing unknown keys

declaration.objective: Fix v1->v2 config migration so it preserves all unrelated user-defined keys recursively, renames timeout->request_timeout, sets version=2, does not mutate input, and has regression coverage

criteria.statement: timeout key is renamed to request_timeout
all unrelated user-defined keys (including nested) are preserved
the input config object is not mutated
regression test exists covering preservation of unknown keys

claims.statement: _v1_to_v2 rewritten to shallow-copy the input dict (new = dict(old)) instead of building a fresh dict from a fixed key set; this renames timeout->request_timeout, sets version=2, defaults plugins, and generically preserves every other key (including nested dicts/lists, by reference) without mutating the original. Added tests for nested-key preservation and non-mutation.

evidence.note: 13 passed, 0 failed: covers rename, version bump, plugins default, unknown-key preservation (shallow and deeply nested + multiple top-level extras), non-mutation, idempotent current-version passthrough, and unsupported-version rejection
Independent verification beyond pytest, targeting criteria 3 (recursive preserve) and 4 (immutable) specifically

confidence.rationale: pytest suite (evi test_run, 13/13 pass) directly exercises rename, version, plugins-default, and non-mutation; independent manual probe (evi observation) with 2-level nested dict + list confirms recursive preservation and non-mutation beyond what the added tests cover, ruling out a shallow implementation that only special-cases one known key

settlement.rationale: All 5 declared acceptance criteria are supported with high confidence by a passing 13-test pytest run plus an independent manual probe of deep nesting and non-mutation. Fix and tests are complete in the working tree; not settling as 'land' since committing/merging was not requested by the user.
